shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrows.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for beforeSession throw handling

Add acceptance tests verifying that when beforeSession throws:
- The error reaches the caller as a rejection (unchanged behavior)
- onError hook is called with the error
- afterSession hook is called for cleanup

These tests currently fail because beforeSession is called before the
try block, so throws escape before catch/finally exist. The fix will
move beforeSession inside the try block, allowing catch/finally to
handle its errors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1
